visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male host with wavy, shoulder-length hair and a purple t-shirt stands in a modern kitchen. He enthusiastically holds two small white plates: one with sliced pineapple and the other with peeled pomelo segments. Large orange and white text overlays the top of the frame. (2) A close-up shot transitions to a pair of silver kitchen scissors being used to remove bones from a raw chicken wing on a wooden cutting board. The hands are precise, showing the interior of the meat and the joint structure. (3) A commercial packet of 'Teppanyaki Sauce' is shown prominently. A gloved hand then mixes several chicken wings with the dark, viscous sauce in a clear glass bowl, ensuring an even coating. (4) The host stuffs a yellow pineapple chunk and then a white pomelo segment into the cavities of the deboned chicken wings. The wings are then placed inside a small toaster oven, which is seen through the glass door while red text indicates baking instructions. (5) A bottle of 'Garlic Flavor Oil' is presented to the camera. An orange silicone brush is used to paint the oil onto the surface of the now-roasted, golden-brown chicken wings sitting on white parchment paper. (6) A bottle of 'Spicy Seasoning' with a green cap is shown. Fine red powder is sprinkled liberally over the glistening, oily chicken wings. (7) Close-up shots feature the wings being squeezed with silver tongs, showing the crispy skin and the juicy fruit filling inside. (8) The male host returns to the screen holding a whole pomelo, gesturing with his fingers and giving a thumbs-up while variety-style graphic text bubbles pop up around him in the kitchen setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2025最強雞翅新吃法. [Variety]: 包水果. (2) [Subtitle]: 準備去骨的雞翅. (3) [Subtitle]: 用這個直接當雞翅的醃醬. [Variety]: 很入味. (4) [Subtitle]: 鳳梨. 柚子. (5) [Subtitle]: 180度烤15-20分鐘. (6) [Logo]: 小磨坊. [Subtitle]: 接下來刷上蒜油. 烤到金黃酥脆 蒜香四溢. (7) [Subtitle]: 最後再來點這個. 鋪上青花椒的香氣. 甘那好呷款內 看起來食慾大開. (8) [Variety]: 雞翅包鳳梨. [Subtitle]: 雞皮裹上青花椒的香氣 辣感很有衝勁. 鳳梨的酸甜又可以把辣味緩和下來 蹦出新滋味 非常香誒! (9) [Variety]: 雞翅包柚子. [Subtitle]: 酥酥脆脆的雞翅 搭配上裡面果汁 柚子又可以解膩 很好吃! (10) [Subtitle]: 出爐前一定要把那個蒜油鋪上去. 柚子是比較清爽的 所以那個蒜香反而更加明顯. (11) [Subtitle]: 拜託 鳳梨跟柚子 你一定要試試看看. [Variety]: 粉讚喲. [Slogan]: 蒜 香 辣 油 粉. (12) [Slogan]: 留言想看拿拿摳 試什麼水果.

The male speaker's voice is high in arousal and positive valence, speaking rapidly about a new recipe. (2) A subtle metallic click of scissors occurs as the speaker explains the deboning technique; the BGM maintains a consistent high tempo. (3) A distinct crinkling sound of plastic is audible when the sauce packet is introduced, followed by a wet, squelching sound as the wings are mixed in the bowl. The speaker's pitch remains elevated and energetic. (4) As the host describes stuffing fruit, the speech rate increases, rhythmically aligning with the visual transitions. A faint hum or buzz from the oven is heard in the background. (5) A soft 'pop' sound effect accompanies the display of the oil bottle, followed by the light friction sound of a brush on meat. (6) A sharp, percussive sprinkling sound signifies the spicy powder being applied, while the BGM continues to pulse with a steady 4/4 rhythm. (7) The speaker's voice becomes more intense and descriptive, highlighting the 'crispy skin' and 'juicy flavor,' accompanied by soft 'slurping' or 'crunching' sound artifacts intended to mimic eating. (8) The track concludes with a final energetic call to action and a friendly, rising intonation as the BGM fades out with a bright synth chord.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative culinary promotion for '小磨坊' (Tomax) seasonings. By demonstrating an unconventional 'fruit-stuffed chicken wing' recipe, it showcases the versatility and flavor enhancement of their teppanyaki sauce, garlic oil, and spicy powder to engage viewers interested in home cooking and food trends.
